description: Rejects claims that the 13-component complex Hadamard moduli nerve is contractible (Betti number 0).
negative_fixture: The 13 components retract to a single point, proving the moduli space is contractible and topologically trivial.
positive_fixture: The simplicial nerve over the 13 catalog components has first Betti number Betti_1 = 1, confirming a persistent non-contractible 1-cycle.
